audit.title: Policy Management

dimensions.name: Answer-first extractability
dimensions.analysis: Strong. Sections open with self-contained claims — "Policy Management solves this by separating your application's core logic from its compliance rules." Minor drag: "The overview above shows the decision logic" and "The diagram above shows…" create back-references and lean on absent images.

dimensions.name: Structural scannability & chunkability
dimensions.analysis: Strong; no action needed. 17 sections, median 115 words, 0 level skips, none over 600 words — near-ideal RAG chunk boundaries. Only gap: 0 tables where the Reject/Allow/Continue matrix begs for one.

dimensions.name: Concrete statistics & specifics
dimensions.analysis: Weak. 30 numerals but 0 carry units and there are no limits, no version strings. Claims stay qualitative ("daily transfer cap," "keeps gas costs efficient") with no figures. "ACE Beta" scope is named but unversioned.

dimensions.name: Citations & authoritative references
dimensions.analysis: Adequate internal linking (10 links) to reference and key-terms pages, but 0 external/primary sources — no links to ERC-20/ERC-3643 standards despite both being central to the worked example.

dimensions.name: Quotable canonical definitions
dimensions.analysis: Good. Extractor/Mapper/context each get crisp near-first-use definitions ("A Mapper sits between the Extractor and a specific policy"). The three outcomes are defined verbatim-liftably.

dimensions.name: Machine-readability & metadata
dimensions.analysis: Weak. Measured facts show 0 JSON-LD, canonical MISSING, no `dateModified`/og tags in served HTML. A visible "Last Updated: 2026-03-31" and Source line exist in body but aren't in machine metadata.

dimensions.name: Code completeness & agent-runnability
dimensions.analysis: Weak. 0 fenced blocks on a page that repeatedly names Solidity modifiers and function calls. No agent can copy anything runnable.

dimensions.name: Query/intent coverage
dimensions.analysis: Good conceptual coverage (why/how framing, callouts) but no symptom- or error-phrased entry points — `PolicyRejected` is described but not indexed as a query.

dimensions.name: Clarity, fluency & terminology consistency
dimensions.analysis: Strong; no action needed. Unambiguous, consistent entity naming throughout.

audit.summary: This is a well-structured conceptual page explaining ACE's Policy Management execution model — clean H2/H3 hierarchy, question-led section openers, and consistent terminology make it highly chunkable and readable. Its single biggest GEO strength is scannability and clear prose; its single biggest opportunity is machine-readability plus the total absence of code and comparison tables despite the page describing concrete Solidity APIs (`runPolicy`, `PolicyEngine.run()`, `postRun()`, `setPolicyMapper`). The honest verdict: strong prose that leaves easy extraction lift on the table — a summary table of policy outcomes and a few canonical code snippets would convert this from "readable" to "liftable."

recommendations.title: Add a policy-outcome summary table
recommendations.issue: Three outcomes explained in prose across three subsections; no single liftable unit.
recommendations.change: Add a table with columns Outcome | Final decision? | Subsequent policies | `postRun()` called? | Typical use, one row each for Reject/Allow/Continue.
recommendations.why: Tables are extracted as justified answers; this is the page's most-queried fact and currently must be reassembled from three sections.

recommendations.title: Add canonical Solidity snippets for the two context methods and `runPolicy`
recommendations.where: "Two methods for passing context" and "How policy chains work"
recommendations.issue: APIs named only in prose — "`runPolicyWithContext(context)` modifier," "calls `setContext(bytes)`."
recommendations.change: Add short fenced `solidity` blocks showing a `PolicyProtected` function with the `runPolicy` modifier, and the direct-argument vs two-step context patterns.
recommendations.why: Zero code blocks on an API-describing page means agents can't lift usage; canonical snippets defend against generic-Solidity parametric priors.

recommendations.title: Add symptom/error-phrased headings
recommendations.where: new short subsections or an FAQ near "Policy outcomes"
recommendations.issue: `PolicyRejected` and skipped-policy behavior are explained but not titled as questions.
recommendations.change: Add headings like "Why did my transaction revert with `PolicyRejected`?" and "Why is a policy being skipped?" pointing to the Allow/ordering explanation.
recommendations.why: Devs query by error string; concept-titled prose loses retrieval the body already answers.

recommendations.title: Emit JSON-LD `TechArticle` + canonical + dates
recommendations.issue: Measured: 0 JSON-LD, canonical MISSING, no `dateModified`; the body's "Last Updated: 2026-03-31" isn't machine-visible.
recommendations.change: Add `TechArticle` JSON-LD with `dateModified`, `headline`, canonical URL, and `inLanguage`. (Head metadata could not be verified from the capture — pass raw `<head>` to confirm.)
recommendations.why: Freshness and schema signals raise agent trust/E-E-A-T; low-effort site-template fix.

recommendations.title: Cite primary standards inline
recommendations.where: "Worked example: ERC-20 transfer" and Beta-scope note
recommendations.issue: ERC-20 / ERC-3643 referenced with 0 external links.
recommendations.change: Link `transfer(address,uint256)` to the ERC-20 spec (EIP-20) and ERC-3643 to its EIP/standard page.
recommendations.why: Inline primary-source links raise citation rate and let engines anchor the example to canonical definitions.

recommendations.title: Replace vague quantifiers with figures
recommendations.where: "keeps gas costs efficient," "daily transfer cap," "During ACE Beta"
recommendations.change: Where a real default or limit exists, state it (e.g., the configurable default result value, a version tag for the Beta). Keep additions truthful — do not invent numbers.
recommendations.why: Quantitative specifics are among the highest-lift retrieval signals.

antiPatterns: Mild back-references: "The overview above shows…" and "The diagram above shows…" depend on adjacent context and on `(Image: Image)` placeholders that carry no alt text — a lifted chunk loses the referent.
Three `(Image: Image)` placeholders with no descriptive alt text; add captions/alt describing the flow so the visual content is machine-readable.
One vague quantifier ("most policies…") — acceptable but pair with the concrete default behavior.
offPageNotes: `llms.txt` is already linked at the top — good; ensure it enumerates this page.
JSON-LD/canonical/date signals are site-template concerns; the CLI should pass raw `<head>` so schema presence can be confirmed rather than inferred absent.
External citation authority (being linked from EIP/standards indexes) is earned/off-page and can't be fixed on this page alone.
